name: Non-decimal sum
description: You are given an array of integers written in base radix . Calculate their sum and output it written in the same base.
input_specification: The first line of the input contains an integer n ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 10 ) — the size of the array. The second line contains an integer radix ( 2 ≤ radix ≤ 36 ) — the base of the numeral system used. Next n lines contain the elements of the array, one per line. Each element is a non-negative integer written in radix -based notation, possibly with leading zeros, which contains between 1 and 5 digits, inclusive. The digits of the notation will be 0, 1, ..., 9, A, B, ..., Z in the given order.
output_specification: Output the sum of array elements in radix -based notation. Use the same format as in the input.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
